The skin texture appears overly plastic-like and uniform. While described as 'smooth', real snake scales usually show some micro-texture or row definition even at a distance. This 'airbrushed' look is a common AI artifact.
The contact points between the snake and the branch are slightly ambiguous. There is minor bleeding where the green body meets the brown bark, lacking sharp occlusion boundaries.
